verdict.rationale: A live probe shows LanceDB serves an llms.txt at docs.lancedb.com with HTTP 200. It indexes machine-readable .md versions of doc pages, and the docs include agent-oriented guides such as 'build with AI agents' and agent branch experiments. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent successfully consuming the llms.txt, and no evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
